RustDesk 1.0.2 upgrades the system packages in the image, which takes the critical OpenSSL findings out.

## 🎨 Design

- **Store buttons in the README** for Community Applications, MOS, ZimaOS and Umbrel.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **System packages are upgraded when the image is built.** The RustDesk API base image ships the Alpine packages of its build date and misses later fixes. They are now brought up to date, so OpenSSL comes at 3.5.9. The remaining findings sit in the upstream API binary and go away with its next release.
